summary: Three strong-value used‑SUV candidates remain active, each under 40 k miles and model year ≥ 2020: the baseline 2020 Toyota RAV4 LE in Chester Springs, the baseline 2022 Honda CR‑V EX‑L in Langhorne, and a newly discovered 2021 Subaru Forester Premium in Sewell, NJ with very low miles. Reliability is excellent across all, though the Forester is priced clearly higher than the RAV4. All require history verification and fee clarification.

trimComparisons.model: Toyota RAV4 LE vs Honda CR‑V EX‑L
trimComparisons.comparison: The RAV4 LE is a more basic trim (cloth seats, no power liftgate), but offers the lowest price (~$____) and good reliability. The CR‑V EX‑L adds leather, power liftgate, moonroof, heated seats, blind‑spot monitoring, offering more comfort and convenience at a somewhat higher price (~$27.9 k).

trimComparisons.model: Subaru Forester Premium vs RAV4 LE
trimComparisons.comparison: The Forester Premium adds AWD and Subaru’s known safety systems (EyeSight), with slightly higher price (~$26.8 k) but much lower mileage (8,669 mi). It offers more features like sunroof, adaptive cruise, Apple CarPlay compared to RAV4 LE, increasing convenience value.
